name: Citlali
description: An elder of the Masters of the Night-Wind, she is a powerful shaman who is well-versed in the ancient rituals and history of Natlan, though she often prefers the quiet company of spirits over people.

skillTalents.name: Obsidian Ceremonial Rite
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks that deal Cryo DMG.
Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a freezing crystal lantern, dealing AoE Cryo DMG after a short casting time.
Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Cryo, Citlali plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Cryo DMG upon impact with the ground.

skillTalents.name: Yohual's Frost-Warded Embrace
skillTalents.description:
Calls upon the spirits of the Night-Wind to create a 'Jade-Star Shield' and deals AoE Cryo DMG. When the Shield is created, Citlali gains 32 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
Jade-Star Shield:
Absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% effectiveness. The Shield's DMG Absorption is based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery. When the shield is created, it applies Cryo to Citlali.
Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
While the Jade-Star Shield is active, Citlali consumes Nightsoul points over time. When the active character within the shield attacks an opponent, the shield will unleash 'Frost-Spirits' that deal Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG. This effect can trigger once every 2s.

skillTalents.name: Glacial Storm of the Ancients
skillTalents.description: Unleashes the full power of the Night-Wind, creating a massive field of 'Frozen Night' that deals continuous Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG to opponents within it. The field periodically restores HP to the active character based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery.

passiveTalents.name: Whispers of the Black Obsidian
passiveTalents.description: When the Jade-Star Shield takes DMG, Citlali gains 1 stack of 'Obsidian Fortitude', increasing the Shield Strength by 5%. Max 5 stacks. This effect lasts until the shield disappears.

passiveTalents.name: Chilling Wind's Caress
passiveTalents.description: For every point of Elemental Mastery Citlali possesses, the DMG dealt by her Frost-Spirits and Glacial Storm is increased by 0.1%. The maximum DMG Bonus obtainable this way is 100%.

constellations.name: Starry Veil of Protection
constellations.description: The DMG Absorption of the Jade-Star Shield is increased by 20%. Additionally, when Citlali triggers a Cryo-related reaction, she recovers 8 Energy. This effect can occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Frozen Heart of the Night
constellations.description: When using Glacial Storm of the Ancients, all nearby party members gain 200 Elemental Mastery for 12s.

constellations.name: Ceremony of the Frost
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Yohual's Frost-Warded Embrace by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Echoes of the Forgotten
constellations.description: When the Jade-Star Shield breaks or expires, it explodes, dealing AoE Cryo DMG equal to 400% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.

constellations.name: Spirits' Eternal Slumber
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Glacial Storm of the Ancients by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dawn of the New Sun
constellations.description: While Citlali is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Nightsoul point consumption of her Frost-Spirits is reduced by 50%. Additionally, the active character shielded by Jade-Star Shield gains 40% Cryo DMG Bonus.
